## How it was checked

- [ ] `make check` passes (format, vet, staticcheck, errcheck, gosec, race tests, coverage, vulnerabilities)
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests, and a bug fix has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] If the report changed: the example was regenerated and the README sample updated
- [ ] If the price table changed: the row is marked verified only after a `check:` line said `exactly`
- [ ] No real session data in the diff
